description: This file defines the MyLeaveEntitlementReport class within the OrangeHRM leave plugin. It extends a base Vue controller, using traits and classes for rendering a leave entitlement report component, which involves preparing and passing leave period data to a front-end component.

classes.name: MyLeaveEntitlementReport
classes.description: Controller class responsible for rendering the leave entitlement report component. It prepares leave period data and passes it to the front-end component.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the leave period data and initializes the Vue component for the leave entitlement report view.
